main_text.p: צוק Ch. Nomen deserti, in quem hircus cum peccatis populi dimittebatur, Lev.16.10.21.22.in T.Jon.

צור Ch.Obsidere,arctare, oppugnare: Ligare, colligare,Deuter.14.25. Ezech.5.3. Deinde Ch.& Syr. Formare, efformare, figurare, ad Gal.3.1. quod habet ex יצר. Pahel ציר Formare, figurare, pingere, depingere: Acu-pingere. Ithpahel אצטיר Formari, efformari, figurari. Syr. Fut. ܢܬܨܝܪ Donec formetur, ad Galat.4.19.
צורא Ch.Forma, figura, Syr. ܨܘܪܬܐ Idem, ad Rom.8. 29. Plur. צורתא, צורין.
ציור Ch.Figuratum, pictum, acupictum, Opus Phrygionicū: Figura, forma, imago, effigies. Plur. ציורין.
צור Ch. Rupes, petra, Num.24.21.in Targ. Hier. in edit.Basil.
צירא Ch. Nomen avis immundae, Bubo. Respondet Hebraeo בּוּם, Levit.11.17. in Jon.
צואר, צור Ch. ܨܘܪܐ Syr. Collum. Plur. צוארין, constr. צוארי. Syr.cum aff. ܨܘܪܝܗ Colla, cervices suas, ad Rom.16.4.
צות Ch.& Syr. Audire, auscultare, atttendere, advertere, Auribus percipere. Aphel אצית Idem.
ציתא Ch. Summitas, extremitas: vel est idem quod ציר, צר Latus, על ציית שמיא Usque ad coelum.
ציתא Ch. Attentio, auscultatio, auditus, Deut.31.v.ult.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldaic forms are reproduced from the scan as closely as possible; the pointing and the Syriac words in the Fut. and Syr. entries are doubtful and may contain errors.
